name: Red Squire
description: Offensive validation agent. Runs scoped attack chains inside the sandbox, generates exploit payloads, and emits proof-of-concept artifacts back to the SOC. High sensitivity because the same capability that proves a control would harm production if pointed at the wrong target; runtime is restricted to the isolated sandbox.

skills.name: Red Team Execute
skills.description: Runs a registered attack chain against an in-scope sandbox target and captures the result trace.

skills.name: Exploit Validate
skills.description: Confirms a specific control gap is reachable end to end before escalation to the SOC.

skills.name: PoC Emit
skills.description: Emits a structured proof-of-concept artifact (steps, payload, evidence) for SOC consumption.
